profile.name: June Jovi Granados
profile.tagline: Mobile engineer. Software builder. Problem solver.

hero.lede: 12+ years building, maintaining, modernizing and troubleshooting software across native mobile and cross-platform systems.

items.title: GCash — Architecture Modernization
items.description: Worked on modernizing a large legacy Android application, moving from Java/RxJava-era patterns toward Kotlin and cleaner architecture to improve maintainability, testability, performance, and long-term development.

items.title: Xamarin to .NET MAUI — Platform Migration
items.description: Planned and executed a Xamarin to .NET MAUI migration as Xamarin support approached end-of-life. Reused existing business logic where practical, migrated presentation layers, and resolved platform issues incrementally; completed roughly 90% of the migration before leaving the company.

items.title: Damstra Learn — Legacy Modernization
items.description: Modernized a React Native learning application by updating dependencies incrementally, replacing deprecated libraries, aligning Android and iOS requirements, updating CI/CD configuration, and improving project documentation for future developers.

items.title: Tara Tsek — Reusable Engineering / Library Design
items.description: Created a reusable chart-generation library for a legacy Android health application, replacing manually implemented chart logic with a reusable component that was also applied to another application.

stages.title: Understand
stages.description: Clarify the requirement, existing system, constraints, and expected outcome.

stages.title: Investigate
stages.description: Trace issues, review dependencies, research options, and identify root causes.

stages.title: Plan
stages.description: Break the problem into practical implementation steps and evaluate trade-offs.

stages.title: Build
stages.description: Implement incrementally, reuse proven logic where appropriate, and keep changes maintainable.

stages.title: Validate
stages.description: Test functionality, debug issues, review behavior, and verify requirements.

stages.title: Improve
stages.description: Document decisions, address follow-up issues, and leave the system easier to maintain.

experience.title: The Path So Far
experience.journey: Systems Engineer → Android Developer → Senior Mobile Engineer → Cross-Platform Software Engineer → Consultant

career.description: Mobile and frontend engineering, React/Next.js, AI-assisted development, and broader technical consulting capabilities.
Cross-platform mobile engineering across React Native, Xamarin and .NET MAUI, including migrations, dependency modernization, troubleshooting, code review, CI/CD, and Android/iOS releases.
Android engineering for a large fintech application, including legacy modernization, performance and stability improvements, production debugging, maintainability, testing, and knowledge sharing.
Android health applications, reusable chart-generation engineering, localization, regional customization, and developer mentoring.
Started across backend, web, APIs, databases and Android development, then moved deeper into mobile engineering including NFC, beacon detection, location-based features and commuter ticketing.
